_comment: Copy this file to <repo-root>/ssot.config.json and edit every field to match your actual project. Remove this _comment field once you've read it — it's documentation, not config.
_rootDocs_comment: The living root files that must always exist. Rename/remove entries if your project uses different filenames, but keep the five-document pattern (SSOT/README/TASK/HANDOFF/AGENTS) if you want to stay consistent with the Syndicate Protocol (docs/SYNDICATE_PROTOCOL.md).
rootDocs: Single Source of Truth Authority Document
_docsHub_comment: Reference documents that must exist under docs/. Add/remove rows to match your actual docs/ folder.
_taskFile_comment: The living task tracker to scan. The script parses every '- [x] ...' line for backtick-quoted file paths and confirms each one exists on disk — this is the automated check for Anti-Drift Rule 6 (no fake 'complete' status).
_test_comment: Set testDir to null (and testFileSuffix/buildConfigFile to null) to skip the test-registration check entirely, e.g. for projects with a different test-discovery mechanism.
_shadowTrackers_comment: Filenames that are never allowed to exist anywhere tracked tasks might hide instead of TASK.md.
